maintenance_led.reason: Sells patented rare-disease medicines like Voxzogo, Vimizim and Palynziq to patients; recurring therapy, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from rare-disease drug sales paid mainly by commercial insurers and government programs; no clear government majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own drug development and sales; only occasional acquisitions, such as an ENPP1 therapy and lysosomal disease medicines.

mission_critical.reason: Only available treatments for conditions like an ultra-rare Batten disease form and achondroplasia; switching risks patient health.

notes: Government share of final payment is uncertain; the website text doesn't say.
